nodes.question: How does the association provide consulting services to its members?
nodes.answer: The association provides consulting services to its members by dedicating themselves to collective bargaining and negotiating on behalf of members. Additionally, they offer consultancy services on various topics such as fashion trends, digitalization, HR law, export law, and sustainability to assist members in their business endeavours (NFA2).
